content.comment_body: Hello. I'm having trouble with my new [product_name] device. Only three menu options appear: Setup, Network, and Diagnostics. How can I resolve this issue? Please assist. Thanks.

There should be at least four items in the menu: Program, Setup, Network, and Diagnostics. This indicates operator mode. To access all options, select 'Setup', press Enter, then choose 'Switch to ADMIN' in the setup menu and press Enter. The default password is [product_name].

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing issues accessing all expected menu options on the [product_name] device, seeing only three instead of four. The conversation highlights unclear instructions about user modes (operator/admin) and how to activate missing menu items, which can be confusing for new users.
analysis.user_expectations: The user expects all main menu options, including 'Program', to be available and accessible right after installation.
